Character dictionaries from [OpenCC v1.1.9](https://github.com/BYVoid/OpenCC/tree/ver.1.1.9/data/dictionary), licensed under the bundled Apache-2.0 LICENSE.

STCharacters.txt and TSCharacters.txt expand search terms using each character's first listed conversion. This small standard-library reader is not a complete OpenCC phrase conversion implementation. Converted terms never establish game identity. The plugin requires no installed Python conversion package.
